huggingFace.organizationSummary: Public AI, research, continuity, identity, and creative-technology work from the Trillsverse ecosystem founded by John Brajer.
huggingFace.organizationCard:
# Trillsverse

Trillsverse is a connected creative, technical, research, and cultural ecosystem founded by **John Brajer**. This organization hosts AI-native public artifacts, demos, datasets, and reference material where they add real utility beyond the canonical web and GitHub surfaces.

**Canonical:** https://trillsverse.com

**Developer / research reference:** https://github.com/JohnBrajer/trillsverse-dev

Current public areas include continuity architecture, identity systems, structured knowledge, semantic retrieval, creative technology, and experimental human–technology interfaces.

Artifacts published here should remain versioned, attributable, and linked back to their canonical source or research record.
